# TRACER - classification from teacher traces

> **TRACER** = Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing.
> Train a task-specific student to predict classification labels directly from embeddings. The student handles accepted requests; the caller's teacher can handle deferrals, including OOD rejections. A separate final check measures accepted teacher agreement. Coverage and savings depend on the data; confidence bounds assume independent, representative examples without adaptive holdout reuse.

This is a free MIT Python library for fixed-label tasks, not a pretrained general
model listed on OpenRouter. No Tracer account is required. The encoder and teacher
are caller-supplied; fitting the student does not fine-tune either. The current
source has no CLI. Hosted app accounts, credits and management are separate.
CHANGELOG.md distinguishes unreleased source from published packages.

## Install
Requires Python 3.12+. CI tests Python 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14.
Published package: pip install tracer-llm
Current checkout with the unreleased corrections: python -m pip install -e .
The published package may not contain the source changes documented here.

## Core API (4 functions)
tracer.fit("traces.jsonl", embeddings=X) → FitResult
tracer.load_router(".tracer", embedder=e) → Router
router.predict("text" or embedding) → {label, decision, accept_score}
tracer.update("new.jsonl", new_embeddings=X_new) → FitResult

decision is "handled" or "deferred"; OOD is included in "deferred", not a third
public value. accept_score is a ranking signal, not a correctness probability.
Check manifest.selected_method and manifest.certification before loading.
Default final holdout fraction=.20; certification_alpha=.10; target agreement=.90.
Fit into a separate directory to evaluate a replacement before promotion: a
completed noncertifying fit publishes selected_method=null in its target directory.

## Trace format (JSONL, one per line)
{"input": "user text", "teacher": "label_from_llm"}

## Embedder (for text-in routing)
Embedder.from_sentence_transformers("model-name")
Embedder.from_endpoint("https://api/embed", headers={...})
Embedder.from_callable(fn)

## Paper
Published paper: TRACER: Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM Classification.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14531

Pricing Capability research paper:
https://github.com/adrida/tracer/blob/main/research/pricing-capability.pdf
Current final submission: 21 pages, dated August 25, 2026.
Defines Capability Alpha under controlled evaluation, develops Price-Implied Uplift,
and places the Spirit case beside a public transaction panel.
